_comment: Workbook exercise plant-chiller-staging (docs/workbook/plant-chiller-staging.md): chiller staging and condenser-water reset on the synthetic-chw-plant-staging plants (generated by CAMBER, no real building), at the trend's own 15-minute resolution and the rules' defaults: chiller_staging warns at 6 and faults at 12 starts a day, or at 25 % / 50 % of running samples below 40 % of the observed peak load; condenser_water_reset calls a slope under 0.3 F per F of wet-bulb a flat setpoint (a warn). The variant plant-chiller-staging--slope05 asks for a slope of 0.5.
